text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to help out with the movie shoot
that Taiki Shuttle had invited me to earlier.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time to shoot the climax scene!
I'm gonna pull off the showcase action scene
perrrfectlyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
We've finally made it this far!
This crucial scene…… we absolutely have to nail it—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
R-Rain……?! This is bad!
Everyone, let's pack up the set for now……!

text_block_list.name: Film Staff A
text_block_list.text:
It managed to stop, but who knows when it'll rain again.
Doing action scenes with this kind of footing looks tough……

text_block_list.name: Film Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Postponing…… would be tough too, right?
Both the schedule and the budget are already stretched thin.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
……Taiki-san, everyone.
Just one take, please.
This duel scene where a single strike decides victory or defeat——

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Let's finish it off in literally just one take……!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Great! A duel scene right after the rain,
so cool! Everyone, let's resume filming!

text_block_list.name: Film Staff
text_block_list.text:
Starting the countdown for the take……!
10 seconds to go, 9, 8, 7——

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
(A make-or-break, one-shot gamble. ……Oh,
my legs are tingling. This sensation is——)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, it's just like entering the starting gate.
Facing a powerful rival, spinning the cylinder of my legs.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Seize the day——
Right now, with all my might, fully immersed——

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's enjoy this challenge……!

text_block_list.name: Film Staff
text_block_list.text: Action!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG! BANGGG!)

text_block_list.name: Film Staff
text_block_list.text:
Incredible……
Taiki-san's expression……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle acted with a fierce, breathtaking intensity.
Just as I was completely overwhelmed by her presence
as she sprinted around, kicking up mud——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Taiki Shuttle stepped into
a deep patch of mud and stumbled heavily.
However——

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yee-haw!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! This is getting more and more fun!
With a big heart, I'll finish this off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANGGG!)

text_block_list.name: Villain Gunman
text_block_list.text:
U-Urgh…… I-Impossible……
You should have lost your footing, how——

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hands up, crook.
You're finished.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: ……～～～! Cuuuuut!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle bet everything on 'this very moment'.
Her tremendous spirit and concentration blew us all away……
That was the kind of shoot it was. And then——

text_block_list.name: Film Festival Host
text_block_list.text:
At this year's Student Film Festival,
the prestigious Grand Prix winner is——
Entry No. 2, "Duel at Yasuda Ranch"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YEEEEEEES!!
Director, we did it!!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it……!!
We really did it, Taiki-san……!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right! We can't just sit around!
Tonight is a dance and meat party~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sheer strength and intensity hidden beneath
Taiki Shuttle's bright and happy demeanor——
through this shoot, I was able to discover a brand new side to her.
